notes.subject: tok tenkyu
notes.rationale: יודוך is from ידה, literally 'throw/cast' extended to give thanks; Tok Pisin uses tok tenkyu for the act of thanking.

notes.subject: ol man khesed bilong yu
notes.rationale: חסידיך is the adjective 'your faithful/pious ones'; alternative rendering is ol gutpela man bilong yu.

notes.subject: Yahwe
notes.rationale: Direct address to Yahwe — the psalmist speaks to God in second person within a third-person psalm.

translation: Olgeta wok bilong yu bai i tok tenkyu long yu, Yahwe, na ol man khesed bilong yu bai i blesim yu.

tokens.gloss: bai i tok tenkyu long yu
na ol man khesed bilong yu
